meta.title: Decidia — The AI that dares to say no
meta.description: Decidia analyses your decisions with the mental models of the best strategists and tells you the truth, even when it hurts.

common.disclaimer: Decidia is a decision aid, not legal, financial or medical advice.

landing.lead: Decidia analyses your decisions with the mental models of the best strategists and tells you the truth, even when it hurts.
landing.small: One free analysis, no sign-up. Report in under 3 minutes.
landing.demoText: I want to quit my job in January to launch an online specialty coffee box. I have €12,000 in savings.
landing.demoNoText: Not in January. With €12,000 and no test sales, you are funding a hypothesis, not a business.
landing.demoInsteadText: Pre-sell 30 boxes within 6 weeks while keeping your salary.

why.title: ChatGPT congratulates you. Decidia contradicts you.
why.sub: An assistant built to answer is built to agree. An important decision needs the opposite.
why.label: Decidia

cards.x: “Great idea, here's how to launch it!”
cards.ok: It looks for what could break and plays devil's advocate against its own recommendation.
It asks 2 or 3 questions about your context, constraints and goal, then personalises.
A journal keeps every decision, its assumptions and what actually happened.
At D+14 and D+30 it asks whether it worked and adjusts the plan.

demo.title: What you get, in three minutes.
demo.sub: Diagnosis, scored options, Blue Ocean grid, devil's advocate, dated plan, quantified risks.

how.title: From question to action plan, in three steps.

steps.d: A few lines are enough. Decidia then asks 2 or 3 short questions, which you can skip.
Inversion, second-order thinking, opportunity cost, Blue Ocean grid… then it attacks its own conclusion.
Scored options, quantified risks, dated plan. Then a follow-up to measure what really happened.

items.d: It challenges your assumptions instead of validating them.
Context questions and your profile shape every analysis.
Your decision journal keeps the thread from one decision to the next.
A justified confidence score and quantified risks, with their assumptions.
It tracks what happened at D+14 and D+30, then adjusts the plan.

new.title: Which decision is holding you back?
new.sub: Describe the situation in a few lines. The more precise you are, the more usefully Decidia can contradict you.
new.placeholder: E.g. I want to quit my job to launch my business. I have €12,000 in savings…
examples: Should I hire my first employee or keep going solo?
I want to quit my job to launch an online coffee box.
Should I cut my prices to beat a cheaper competitor?
My product has stalled for 6 months: pivot or persist?
new.minChars: A few more words, 20 characters minimum.
new.outOfScope: This question belongs with a professional (doctor, lawyer…). Decidia cannot help here.
new.limit: Too many requests in a row. Try again in a few minutes.
